welcome.title: Choose a folder for your OpenTreasury data
welcome.body: OpenTreasury keeps every transaction, account, and label as plain files inside a folder you control. Pick where you want that folder to live — you can move or back it up later just like any other folder.
welcome.bulletAnyFolder: Any normal disk folder works — local drive, external drive, network share.
welcome.bulletCloudSync: Want cloud sync? Point this at a folder inside OneDrive, SharePoint, Dropbox, or Google Drive and the app will follow.
welcome.bulletNoLockIn: No lock-in: your data stays in that folder. Uninstalling OpenTreasury never touches it.
welcome.restarting: Saving your choice and restarting OpenTreasury…

folder.title: Where should OpenTreasury store your data?
folder.body: Choose a folder for your treasury workspace. If you plan to share with other board members, pick a folder inside OneDrive or a shared drive.
folder.legacy_file_hint: An unencrypted file was found in this folder and will be ignored. Move or delete it if you no longer need it.

show.title: Your data, encrypted and shared securely.
show.body: OpenTreasury keeps your treasury data private. We'll set up a recovery code now — this is the **only** way to get your data back if you lose access to this computer, and the way other board members will join this workspace.
show.grid_caption: Store this somewhere safe, away from this computer. Share it with anyone who needs access to this workspace — it's the key to your shared treasury.

confirm.title: Confirm your recovery code
confirm.prompt: To make sure you've got it right, enter the words at these positions:
confirm.footer: If you close OpenTreasury now, we'll start over next time.
confirm.error: That doesn't match. Please check and try again.

done.title: Your workspace is encrypted.
done.body: Anyone you share the recovery code with can join from their own computer.

join.title: Join an existing workspace.
join.body: Point to the shared folder and enter the 12-word recovery code you received from the workspace owner.
join.label_prompt: What should we call this computer?
join.error: That recovery code doesn't match. Please check and try again.

success.title: You're in.
success.body: OpenTreasury will unlock automatically from now on.

recovery.title: Welcome back.
recovery.body: To unlock your treasury data, please enter your 12-word recovery code.
recovery.error: That recovery code doesn't match. Please check and try again.
